Metadata.title: Brika - Self-hosted Automation Hub
Metadata.description: Build, run, and integrate automations locally. One binary. No cloud. Full control.

Hero.tagline: A self-hosted automation hub that runs on your machine. One binary, no cloud, full control.

Features.heading: Why Brika
Features.subheading: Self-hosted, hackable, open source. The automation hub for builders.

localFirst.title: Your data, your hub
localFirst.description: Every workflow, every dashboard, every byte stays on your machine. No telemetry sent home, no cloud account required, no third party reading your sensors. Brika is yours, end to end.

alwaysOn.title: Built to keep running
alwaysOn.description: Each plugin runs in its own Bun process. If one misbehaves, the rest keep going. Your hub stays up, quietly, year after year.

visualBuilder.title: Drag, drop, done
visualBuilder.description: Workflows in the editor, bricks on your dashboard. Same drag-and-drop, same live preview, same plugins powering both.

extensible.title: Built to be extended
extensible.description: Plugins are real TypeScript projects. Type-safe blocks powered by Zod, React bricks compiled to scoped ESM, hot-reload during dev. Ship as an npm package.

runsAnywhere.title: Light enough for a Pi
runsAnywhere.description: One binary, no Node, no Docker required. Bundled Bun runtime, embedded UI. Mac, Linux, Windows, Raspberry Pi, boots in under a second.

CliDemo.heading: Live in your terminal
CliDemo.subheading: Brika's fullscreen TUI ships in the same binary. Manage plugins, watch workflows, tail logs — all without leaving the terminal.

Bricks.heading: Your dashboard, your data
Bricks.subheading: Bricks are live dashboard cards that plugins provide. Weather, timers, device controls, music. Each brick displays real-time data and actions on a customizable grid.
Bricks.hint: Try dragging the cards to rearrange them.

RemoteAccess.heading: Reach your hub from anywhere
RemoteAccess.subheading: Pick a name for your hub. Type hub.brika.dev/myhub in any browser, and your traffic goes straight to the hub at home. No port forwarding, no VPN, no relay sitting in the middle.

p2p.title: A direct line to your hub
p2p.description: WebRTC opens a direct connection between your browser and the hub at home. Once it’s up, nothing else sits in the middle. Not us, not your ISP, not anyone.

encrypted.title: Encrypted in transit
encrypted.description: Every byte rides on WebRTC’s built-in encryption (DTLS). Sessions are unlocked by short-lived tickets that expire after 60 seconds, so even a leaked URL is dead before anyone can reuse it.

nameBased.title: A name, not an address
nameBased.description: Give your hub a short handle, the way you’d pick a username. We remember which hub answers to it. You never have to know its IP, set up dynamic DNS, or care where you are.

noPortForward.title: Works behind any router
noPortForward.description: Home Wi-Fi, mobile data, a café network, your office firewall: they all work. Nothing to forward, nothing to configure on the router.

selfHosted.title: Or run your own front door
selfHosted.description: Don’t want to use ours? The wire protocol is open. Run a coordinator on whatever you like: Bun, Node, Deno, a Cloudflare Worker, your own VPS. Your hub talks only to it, and you’re the only one handing out tickets.

diagram.aria: Diagram of a browser connecting to a Brika hub via WebRTC. The coordinator only matters during the brief handshake.
diagram.caption: The coordinator finds your hub by name and gets you two introduced. After that, the conversation is just between you.

Plugins.heading: Extend with plugins
Plugins.subheading: Discover community and official plugins from the npm registry.
Plugins.buildYourOwnDescription: Scaffold a plugin in one command. Define blocks, bricks, and integrations with full TypeScript inference. Ship as an npm package. Brika handles isolation, IPC, and hot-reload.

OpenSource.heading: Built in the open
OpenSource.description: Brika is MIT-licensed and open source. Read the code, fork it, contribute. It’s yours.

Clay.heading: The UI kit behind Brika
Clay.description: Clay is our open-source React component library, token system, and themes. Every surface in Brika is built on it, and you can use it in your own apps too.
